pr_title: Permit overwritten blobs to be missing
pr_body:
Today blob overwrites are not completely atomic, there is an
intermediate state in which the blob is missing, but the repository
analyser does not fully account for that intermediate state.

This commit relaxes the check for missing blobs if they were
overwritten.

Closes #69087
pr_comments:
> LGTM, though we should still fix the way FsRepository does the overwriting IMO

Indeed; at least now we know we can detect it in tests :)

comments:
I muted fairly aggressively, disabling `AbstractSnapshotRepoTestKitRestTestCase#testRepositoryAnalysis`:
* a7c5c2e0ea82d2b35960b5ce4763bdd76d486ff1 (master)
* 568906116ac1a76847cc7676235ab18a48f2c81b (7.x)

Thanks @jtibshirani, I've also seen one of the YAML REST tests failing similarly, however we need to understand why and I haven't been able to reproduce this locally (in thousands of test iterations) so I'd like to leave some of these failing tests running in CI with the additional logging introduced in #69098 for now.

review_comments:
Note that we don't completely ignore the not-found case, we handle it correctly in `onReadsComplete()`:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/f2c18d4d580921d7370b5c12fd9e5b053ba25c26/x-pack/plugin/snapshot-repo-test-kit/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/repositories/blobstore/testkit/BlobAnalyzeAction.java#L473-L483

I added this extra check here during some testing and clearly forgot to remove it.
